gui.kingdomtreasury.title: Realm Treasury · Royal Treasury
gui.kingdomtreasury.cancel_payroll_hint: Cancel the entire cycle awaiting funds. Salary claims from earlier cycles remain saved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.donation_hint: Donations transfer your own money into the public treasury. They are contributions, not personal deposits.
gui.kingdomtreasury.credit_hint: Ready to collect: %s. Anything that cannot be collected stays saved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.invalid_amount: Enter a positive amount. Use whole emeralds or euros with up to two decimal places.
gui.kingdomtreasury.mode_hint: Choose a percentage of contract rewards or a fixed tax each cycle. The two modes are alternatives.
gui.kingdomtreasury.policy_hint: Choose contract percentage or fixed tax per cycle. Market sales tax and casino profit tax are independent. Casino tax applies to owner profit withdrawals in Chronicle coins, after returning deposited capital. Salaries spend existing treasury funds. Existing contracts keep their terms.
gui.kingdomtreasury.invalid_policy: Check the rules: both taxes 0–100%, cycle 1–720 hours, activity 1–1440 minutes, reputation 0–100. Amounts must be nonnegative.
gui.kingdomtreasury.collect_hint: Collect delivered materials belonging to the kingdom. Anything that does not fit stays saved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.cancel_contract_hint: Cancel this open contract. Its reserved reward returns to the kingdom treasury.
gui.kingdomtreasury.invalid_contract: Enter a title, a valid material identifier, 1–4096 items and a positive reward.
gui.kingdomtreasury.no_response: The server did not respond. Reopen the treasury before repeating an action.
gui.kingdomtreasury.activity_summary: Eligibility: %s active minutes during the cycle
gui.kingdomtreasury.participation_hint: Activity is measured during each cycle. Reputation is granted for completed public contracts, subject to the daily limit. The publishing requirement applies to new private contracts.
gui.kingdomtreasury.contracts_empty: There are no open public contracts.
gui.kingdomtreasury.public_contract_hint: The full reward is reserved from the public treasury. Delivered materials belong to the kingdom. Cancelling an open contract returns its reward to the treasury.
gui.kingdomtreasury.donation_amount_hint: Choose a positive amount in the selected donation currency. Donations cannot be withdrawn as personal deposits.
gui.kingdomtreasury.tax_percent_hint: 0–100%, with up to two decimal places. A 20 € reward at 5% pays 19 € to the worker and 1 € to the kingdom.
gui.kingdomtreasury.fixed_tax_hint: A nonnegative amount per eligible player each cycle. Used only in fixed tax mode.
gui.kingdomtreasury.salary_hint: A nonnegative payment per eligible player each cycle, funded by the public treasury.
gui.kingdomtreasury.period_hours_hint: Choose a cycle between 1 and 720 hours.
gui.kingdomtreasury.active_minutes_hint: Choose 1–1440 active minutes required during a cycle.
gui.kingdomtreasury.minimum_reputation_h: Choose 0–100. Players below this requirement can still complete contracts and collect rewards.
gui.kingdomtreasury.reputation_reward_hi: Choose 0–100 reputation per completed public contract. Chronicles RP is required.
gui.kingdomtreasury.daily_limit_hint: Choose 0–100 reputation earned from public contracts per UTC day.
gui.kingdomtreasury.contract_title_hint: Give the public contract a short, clear title (maximum 64 characters).
gui.kingdomtreasury.contract_item_hint: Use a full identifier, such as minecraft:oak_log. Only unmodified materials may be delivered.
gui.kingdomtreasury.contract_reward_hint: The full amount will be reserved from the kingdom treasury. Use whole emeralds or euros with up to two decimal places.
gui.kingdomtreasury.session_missing: Open a Crown Treasury chest to use this menu.
gui.kingdomtreasury.chest_range: Return to the Crown Treasury chest and open it again.
gui.kingdomtreasury.invalid_request: This request could not be completed. Check the values and available funds.
gui.kingdomtreasury.not_manager: Only the current ruler may manage the treasury.
gui.kingdomtreasury.realm_authority: Realm Council appoints the treasury ruler through a sworn, active mandate.
gui.kingdomtreasury.realm_unavailable: Realm Council authority is unavailable. Management is locked; funds remain saved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.contracts_unavailabl: Public contracts require Contracts & Bounties 0.3.1 or later.
gui.kingdomtreasury.profile_required: Digital money requires Chronicles RP and a created character.
gui.kingdomtreasury.insufficient_money: Your wallet does not contain enough money.
gui.kingdomtreasury.wallet_full: There is no room for this payment. Unclaimed money remains saved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.insufficient_funds: The treasury does not have enough available funds.
gui.kingdomtreasury.no_pending_payroll: There is no pending payroll to cancel.
gui.kingdomtreasury.donated: Your contribution was deposited in the public treasury.
gui.kingdomtreasury.claimed: Your salary was paid. Any remaining credit stays saved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.nothing_claimable: There is no payable salary, or your inventory is full.
gui.kingdomtreasury.policy_saved: Kingdom rules saved. Market tax applies to new purchases; existing contract terms stay locked.
gui.kingdomtreasury.published: Public contract published with the reward reserved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.cancelled: Public contract cancelled; its reserved reward returned to the treasury.
gui.kingdomtreasury.collected: Kingdom materials collected. Any remaining items stay saved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.nothing_materials: There are no materials to collect, or your inventory is full.
gui.kingdomtreasury.payroll_cancelled: The frozen payroll cycle was cancelled. Reserved salary claims remain saved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.donation_currency_hi: Choose emeralds or Chronicles RP money. Changing currency resets the donation amount to 0.
gui.kingdomtreasury.policy_currency_hint: Changing currency resets the fixed tax and salary to 0. Enter new amounts before saving; stored funds and credits keep their original currency.
gui.kingdomtreasury.currency_unavailable: Chronicles RP is unavailable. Emeralds remain available; stored money is preserved.
gui.kingdomtreasury.credit_unavailable: Saved money: %s. Install Chronicles RP again to collect it.
gui.kingdomtreasury.wallet_unavailable: Create a Chronicles RP character to use this wallet.
gui.kingdomtreasury.market_tax_percent_h: 0–100%, with up to two decimal places. Independent of contract and fixed taxes. A €20 sale at 5% pays €19 to the seller and €1 to the treasury. Tax is rounded down on the total purchase.
gui.kingdomtreasury.markets_unavailable: Realm Markets integration is unavailable. Sales tax stays saved in the market ledger until it can be collected.
message.kingdomtreasury.donation_receive: The treasury received a donation of %s.
message.kingdomtreasury.salary_available: %s in salary is now funded. Collect it at the Crown Chest.
message.kingdomtreasury.salary_waiting: %s in salary is waiting for you at the Crown Chest.
message.kingdomtreasury.contract_income: The treasury received %s in contract tax or refunds.
message.kingdomtreasury.market_income: The treasury received %s in market sales tax.
realm.treasury.question: Title (up to 120 characters)
realm.treasury.vote.empty: No public vote is currently open. Proposals are announced from the treasury chest.
realm.treasury.vote.author: Proposed by %s
realm.treasury.vote.secret: Secret ballot: others cannot see your choice. You may change your vote until the deadline. A tie rejects the proposal.
realm.treasury.vote.ineligible: Only non-spectator players online when the poll opened can vote in this proposal.
realm.treasury.general.hint: Ask about any topic. Citizens vote yes or no; this poll does not spend treasury funds.
realm.treasury.propose.rules: Voting lasts %s. Minimum participation: %s%%. A benefit is activated only after approval. Its cost is reserved while voting.
realm.treasury.benefits.empty: No funded benefits are currently active. Propose one at the treasury chest.
realm.treasury.history.empty: Decisions will appear here once a public vote closes.
realm.treasury.description.harvest: Crops gain a %s%% extra chance to grow while the benefit lasts.
realm.treasury.description.works: %s%% faster survival mining, preserving potion effects.
realm.treasury.description.feast: Survival activities cause %s%% less hunger exhaustion.
realm.treasury.description.knowledge: Players gain %s%% more experience from positive XP rewards.
realm.treasury.error.cooldown: Wait for the next proposal window.
realm.treasury.error.busy: Another proposal or a treasury refund is pending.
realm.treasury.error.active_limit: This benefit is already active or the active-benefit limit has been reached.
realm.treasury.error.closed: This vote has ended or the proposal has changed.
realm.treasury.error.ineligible: You are not eligible for this vote.
realm.treasury.error.disabled: This feature is disabled by the server administrator.
realm.treasury.error.quote: The price or duration changed. Review the new offer.
realm.treasury.error.authority: Only the sworn President or an emergency administrator may propose at the chest.
realm.treasury.error.rate: Please wait a moment before trying again.
realm.treasury.error.funds: The treasury cannot fund this proposal.
realm.treasury.error.persistence: The treasury could not confirm storage. Check the current proposal before retrying.
realm.treasury.description_hint: Explain the proposal to the citizens...
realm.treasury.description_empty: This earlier proposal has no separate description.
realm.treasury.error.description_require: Write a description before announcing the vote.
realm.treasury.loan.title: Royal Credit Counter
realm.treasury.loan.subtitle: Public treasury · written contracts
realm.treasury.loan.purpose_hint: For example: tools for my workshop
realm.treasury.loan.request_hint: Request up to %s. The President will offer fixed terms for you to review and sign.
realm.treasury.loan.approval_hint: Approving reserves public funds. The borrower receives them only after signing. These terms cannot be changed after approval.
realm.treasury.loan.limits_hint: Limits: %s%% interest, %s payments, up to %s days between payments.
realm.treasury.loan.self_hint: Your own application requires an administrator to approve it.
realm.treasury.loan.overdue_hint: Payment overdue. The agreed debt stays fixed; settle the outstanding credit to borrow again.
realm.treasury.loan.signature_terms: Signing transfers the principal from the public treasury to your wallet and starts the repayment schedule above. Payments are manual at any credit counter. Interest is fixed and does not compound. The first installment is due one agreed interval after signing.
realm.treasury.loan.fixed_terms: Real-time dates. Agreed interest stays fixed. Manual payments and early full repayment are available at any credit counter.
realm.treasury.loan.footer: Public credit · fixed terms · manual repayments
realm.treasury.loan.empty_mine: Your open applications and active credit appear here.
realm.treasury.loan.empty_review: No open requests on this page.
realm.treasury.loan.empty_archive: Completed and closed agreements appear here.
realm.treasury.loan.select_hint: Select an agreement to read its terms, payment schedule and recorded decisions.
realm.treasury.loan.message.offered: Offer issued; public funds are reserved.
realm.treasury.loan.message.accepted: Agreement signed. The principal is in your wallet.
realm.treasury.loan.message.paid: Installment paid to the public treasury.
realm.treasury.loan.message.declined: Application refused; any reserved principal was returned.
realm.treasury.loan.message.cancelled: Application cancelled; any reserved principal was returned.
realm.treasury.loan.error.limits: The terms exceed administrator limits or contain invalid values.
realm.treasury.loan.error.amount: Enter a positive amount within the loan limit.
realm.treasury.loan.error.one_open: Complete or close your existing application before requesting another.
realm.treasury.loan.error.capacity: The credit register is full. Existing agreements remain payable.
realm.treasury.loan.error.cooldown: Please wait before submitting another application.
realm.treasury.loan.error.stale: This agreement has changed or the offer has expired. Reopen the counter.
realm.treasury.loan.error.self_approval: The President cannot approve their own application. An administrator can review it.
realm.treasury.loan.error.authority: Only the current sworn President or an administrator can make this decision.
realm.treasury.loan.error.balance: Your wallet does not contain enough money for this payment.
realm.treasury.loan.error.wallet_full: There is not enough room in your wallet or inventory to receive the principal.
realm.treasury.loan.error.profile: Create your Realm Origins character before using digital credit.
realm.treasury.loan.error.recovery: A retained credit receipt requires recovery. Public financial operations are paused; preserve the world files and reconnect the borrower.
realm.treasury.loan.error.session: Return to a nearby credit counter and open it again.
realm.treasury.loan.error.rate: Please wait a moment before confirming another action.
realm.treasury.loan.error.disabled: New public loans are disabled. Existing agreements can still be paid.
realm.treasury.loan.error.funds: The public treasury cannot fund this offer.
realm.treasury.loan.error.storage: The starting wallet could not be saved. The transfer has not started; check world storage and try again.
